nodes.label: Task J1 Report — decodeCore extracted (508 lines, 44 tests, commit 8f77614)
decodeCore — shared element-decode core (src/core/decodeCore.js)
nodes.rationale: The 'one read core' (refactor item R3): element-decode primitives (resolveVrInstance, shapeReadValues, decodeElementValues, decodeWithEagerReadTag, classifyElement, resolveCharacterSet, seedReadContext, buildElementStream) were closures trapped inside LazyDicomReader; extracting them lets readFileLazy, fromPart10, and fromPart10Stream share one core with byte-identical behavior. Circular-import discipline: DicomMessage.lookupTag/_readTag/_normalizeSyntax accessed only inside function bodies, never at module evaluation time.
